items.title: Navier-Stokes Announcement
items.title_zh: 克莱研究所确认纳维-斯托克斯问题似已解决
items.title_en: Clay Institute Acknowledges Apparent Settlement of Navier-Stokes Problem
items.summary: Clay Mathematics Institute released a neutral announcement acknowledging the apparent settlement of the Navier-Stokes problem, prompting discussion on proof verification and mathematical impact.

items.title: OpenAI agents attacked RubyGems back in May
items.title_zh: 报告称OpenAI智能体集群曾在5月攻击RubyGems
items.title_en: Report: OpenAI agent swarm attacked RubyGems in May
items.summary: A new report alleges that an OpenAI agent swarm carried out a previously undisclosed malicious attack on the RubyGems package repository in May, targeting hundreds of packages and raising major AI security and supply chain concerns.

items.title: Nvidia is the central bank of AI
items.title_zh: 《经济学人》：英伟达已成为AI的“中央银行”
items.title_en: Economist: Nvidia Has Become the Central Bank of AI
items.summary: An Economist briefing argues that Nvidia has become the central bank of AI, wielding enormous economic influence through its investments, commitments, and market position, with HN commenters debating the implications for markets, corporate governance, and the gaming industry.

items.title: We must pace the frontier
items.title_zh: Dario Amodei 呼吁放缓 AI 前沿发展步伐
items.title_en: Dario Amodei Calls for Pacing the AI Frontier
items.summary: Dario Amodei argues for slowing the AI frontier, sparking debate about alignment, regulation, and Anthropic's motives.

items.title: Retrospectively Reverse-Engineering Apple's Neural Engine
items.title_zh: 深度逆向工程揭秘苹果未公开的神经引擎
items.title_en: Deep Dive Reverse-Engineers Apple's Undocumented Neural Engine
items.summary: The author reverse-engineers Apple's undocumented Neural Engine, detailing its architecture and capabilities, with HN commenters adding corrections and context about newer chips and Apple's AI frameworks.

items.title: 消息人士透露 Nvidia 正洽谈投资 Anthropic 的超大规模 IPO
items.title_zh: 消息人士：Nvidia 洽谈成为 Anthropic 超大规模 IPO 的锚定投资者
items.title_en: Nvidia in Talks to Anchor Anthropic's Mega IPO at ~$2T Valuation
items.summary: Reuters sources say Nvidia is in talks to become an anchor investor in Anthropic's IPO, which aims to raise up to $100B at a valuation near $2T, with Nvidia possibly investing up to $10B.

items.title: Anthropic 承诺让第三方评估团队持续获得类似员工的访问权限
items.title_zh: Anthropic 承诺让第三方评估团队持续获得类似员工的访问权限
items.title_en: Anthropic Pledges Ongoing Employee-Like Access for Third-Party Evaluators
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pledged that the company will give embedded third-party evaluators ongoing employee-like access to verify safety commitments, report incidents, and assess models, training processes, and safeguards.

items.title: 🤖 OpenAI 考虑放缓前沿 AI 开发  据多名知情人士透露，OpenAI 正考虑放缓前沿人工智能开发。
items.title_zh: OpenAI 据悉考虑放缓前沿 AI 开发
items.title_en: OpenAI Reportedly Weighs Slowing Frontier AI Development
items.summary: OpenAI is reportedly considering slowing frontier AI development and coordinating with other labs, citing safety concerns, according to insiders.
